title.zh: 算出一条路线的耗电量
title.en: Calculate the Cost of One Route

brief.zh: 完成 path_cost(costs, route)。route 是从起点开始的 [x, y] 坐标列表。累加后来进入的每一格的耗电量。
brief.en: Complete path_cost(costs, route). The route is a list of [x, y] coordinates starting with the start tile. Add the energy cost of every tile entered after that.

concept.zh: 按路径坐标读取二维表
concept.en: Use route coordinates to index a grid of costs

hints.zh: 从下标 1 开始循环，略过起点。先取 y 那一排，再取其中的 x。
hints.en: Loop from index 1 to skip the start. Select row y first, then column x.

hints.zh: 站着不动的路线只有起点，耗电量是 0。
hints.en: A route that stays put only has a starting tile and costs 0.
